name: StakeWise V3
description: Non-custodial ETH staking through StakeWise V3 vaults. Deposit ETH for vault shares, mint osETH against the shares as collateral, and exit through the exit queue. Vaults are created by factories; this entry covers the Ethereum mainnet core contracts.

keyFunctions.description: Deploy a new vault proxy from the current implementation. Argument 1: ABI-encoded vault init params (capacity, fee percent, metadata hash; see the v3-core repo). Argument 2: true to deploy a dedicated MEV escrow for the vault. Returns the new vault address. Check the StakeWise docs before sending ETH with the call.
Current vault implementation that new vaults point to.
Address of the MEV escrow contract used by vaults created with their own escrow.
Admin address that the factory assigns to new vaults.
Deploy a new ERC-20 variant vault from the current ERC-20 implementation. Same arguments as VaultFactory.createVault: encoded init params and the MEV escrow flag. Returns the vault address.
Current ERC-20 vault implementation that new vaults point to.
True if the address is a vault registered by the protocol.
True if the address is an approved vault factory.
True if the address is an approved vault implementation.

Deposit ETH (msg.value) and mint vault shares to receiver. Argument 1: receiver. Argument 2: referrer (zero address if none). Returns the shares minted. Shares track the vault's assets, so the share price rises as rewards are added.

Apply a signed rewards update first, then deposit. Use this when the vault state is stale. Arguments: receiver, referrer, and the harvest params (rewards root, reward delta, unlocked MEV reward, merkle proof) from the StakeWise rewards API.

Mint osETH against your vault shares. Arguments: receiver, osETH amount in osToken shares, referrer. Minting raises the position's debt, so keep it under the vault's LTV limit (see OsTokenConfig.getConfig) or the position can be liquidated.
Burn osETH held against your position to reduce its debt. Argument: osToken shares to burn. Burn your osETH first.

Start an exit: burn vault shares into the exit queue and receive a position ticket. Arguments: shares, receiver. Exits are queued, not instant. Claim the ETH with claimExitedAssets after the queue processes the ticket.
Claim ETH for a processed exit queue position. Arguments: position ticket, timestamp and exit queue index, taken from the exit queue data. Reverts until the position is processed.
Apply a signed rewards update (rewards root, reward delta, unlocked MEV reward, merkle proof) so the share price is current. Anyone can submit a valid update.

Queue osETH for redemption into ETH. Per the StakeWise docs, the user sends osETH to the redeemer and receives a ticket. Arguments: amount and receiver (check get_abi for the exact units). Settlement depends on minters' positions and checkpoints.

actions.name: deposit ETH to a vault
actions.how: CommunityVault.deposit(receiver, referrer) with ETH value; call updateStateAndDeposit when isStateUpdateRequired() is true

actions.name: mint osETH
actions.how: CommunityVault.mintOsToken(receiver, osTokenShares, referrer) after checking OsTokenConfig.getConfig and the position health

actions.name: repay osETH
actions.how: approve osETH to the vault if needed, then CommunityVault.burnOsToken(shares)

actions.name: exit to ETH via vault
actions.description: Withdraw vault shares as ETH through the exit queue
actions.how: CommunityVault.enterExitQueue(shares, receiver) to get a ticket; after processing, CommunityVault.claimExitedAssets(ticket, timestamp, index)

actions.name: redeem osETH
actions.description: Sell osETH back for ETH through the redeemer
actions.how: approve osETH to OsTokenRedeemer, then enterExitQueue(amount, receiver); later processExitQueue() and claimExitedAssets(ticket, timestamp)

risks: Withdrawals are queued. A vault exit can wait for validator exits when the vault has little withdrawable ETH; withdrawableAssets() shows what is available now.
osETH minting creates debt. If the position drifts past the liquidation threshold, it can be liquidated; keep a margin under the LTV limit.
Share price depends on oracle-signed rewards updates. A stale vault needs updateState before deposits or mints use the current price.
Vaults are operated by their admins and node operators. Vault risk (validator slashing, operator behaviour, MEV escrow) is separate from the core protocol.
Core contracts are upgradeable and admin controlled. Check the StakeWise docs for the current governance setup.
notes: Ethereum mainnet contracts from the StakeWise networks page (updated 2026-10-01). CommunityVault is listed as a deployed vault; its ABI is read from the implementation it proxies. Other vault types (FoxVault, GenesisVault and custom vaults) are on the same page and can be added. The page also covers Gnosis and Hoodi deployments, which are not included here. Vault deposits are not tied to a single address; use VaultsRegistry.vaults(address) to check a vault is official.
